item.description: - **Midterm election betting passes 220 million dollars on Kalshi and Polymarket, more than double the 2024 cycle** — More than 220 million dollars has been wagered on 2026 midterm outcomes across Kalshi and Polymarket, more than double the 92 million dollars recorded in the entire 2024 congressional cycle, according to a Reuters report citing Anti-Corruption Data Collective analysis.
